summary: Europa-Universität Flensburg's Sustainable Energy and Development master's (SEDev) is one of DAAD's development-related courses for engineers from developing countries. DAAD scholarship applications go straight to Flensburg. The scholarship round for the batch that starts in 2027 closed on 31 August 2026; self-funded applications close on 30 November 2026.
meta_title: Flensburg SEDev: DAAD EPOS master's in sustainable energy
meta_description: Flensburg's Sustainable Energy and Development master's takes DAAD EPOS scholars: engineers with two years' work experience. The 2027 DAAD round has closed.
covers: A DAAD scholarship, subject to DAAD approving the funds. Our DAAD page explains what DAAD development scholarships pay.
eligibility: A bachelor's of 3.5 years (seven semesters) or more in engineering.
Two years of work experience, with written proof. Internships do not count.
TOEFL iBT 80, IELTS 6 in every band, or Cambridge FCE. A letter saying you were taught in English is not enough.
Nationality of a country on DAAD's development list for the call.
how_to_apply: DAAD applicants apply directly through Flensburg's SEDev website, with the DAAD form and checklist signed by hand.

Send one PDF with a Europass CV, your bachelor's certificate with translation, transcripts, a motivation letter of about 1,000 words, proof of two years' work, two signed recommendations (professional and academic) and your English test.
DAAD applicants are interviewed between December and January, and Flensburg decides with DAAD.
watch_out: The DAAD deadline for the 2027–2029 batch (pre-semester from 1 September 2027, course from 1 March 2028) was 31 August 2026. Watch the page for the next round.
A four-year KNUST or Nigerian engineering degree meets the 3.5-year rule.
Book IELTS or TOEFL early: Flensburg does not accept medium-of-instruction letters.
documents: DAAD application form and checklist (DAAD applicants)
Bachelor's certificate with translation and transcripts

faq.q: Is the Flensburg SEDev DAAD round open?
faq.a: No. The round for the 2027–2029 batch closed on 31 August 2026, and the next round has not been announced.

faq.q: Who can apply to SEDev with DAAD funding?
faq.a: Engineers with a bachelor's of at least 3.5 years and two years of work experience, from countries on DAAD's development list.

faq.q: Does Flensburg accept an English-taught degree instead of IELTS?
faq.a: No. A medium-of-instruction letter is not sufficient; you need TOEFL, IELTS or Cambridge FCE.
